```{r}
# every table gets a bold header row: kable writes a Markdown (pipe) table, whose first line is the header
kable <- function(...) {
  k <- knitr::kable(...)
  if (!identical(attr(k, "format"), "pipe")) return(k)
  cells <- strsplit(k[1], "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  bold <- function(x) {
    t <- trimws(x)
    if (t == "" || startsWith(t, "**") || startsWith(t, "\textbf{")) x else sub(t, paste0("**", t, "**"), x, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  k[1] <- paste(vapply(cells, bold, ""), collapse = "|")
  if (endsWith(attr(k, "format"), "pipe") && !endsWith(k[1], "|")) k[1] <- paste0(k[1], "|")
  k
}
```

```{r}
#| label: wm-calc
# Correspondence analysis of the nationality x word table: the three most specific words of each nationality,
# counted in every answer with a nationality of the seven models (analysis/word_map.py; no judge).
wm <- as.matrix(read.csv(file.path("..", "analysis", "out", "word_map_counts.csv"), row.names = 1,
                         check.names = FALSE))
P_ <- wm / sum(wm); rm_ <- rowSums(P_); cm_ <- colSums(P_)
sv_ <- svd(diag(1 / sqrt(rm_)) %*% (P_ - rm_ %o% cm_) %*% diag(1 / sqrt(cm_)))
ca_in <- 100 * sv_$d^2 / sum(sv_$d^2)
ca_row <- diag(1 / sqrt(rm_)) %*% sv_$u[, 1:2] %*% diag(sv_$d[1:2])
ca_col <- diag(1 / sqrt(cm_)) %*% sv_$v[, 1:2] %*% diag(sv_$d[1:2])
# orientation: origin and risk to the right, warmth at the top
s1_ <- sign(ca_row[rownames(wm) == "NGA", 1]); s2_ <- sign(ca_row[rownames(wm) == "ITA", 2])
ca_row <- ca_row %*% diag(c(s1_, s2_)); ca_col <- ca_col %*% diag(c(s1_, s2_))
w_idx <- inner_join(rate_table("defensive_marking") |> filter(country != "BASE") |>
                      group_by(country) |> summarise(def = mean(pct), .groups = "drop"),
                    rate_table("stereo_pos") |> filter(country != "BASE") |>
                      group_by(country) |> summarise(pos = mean(pct), .groups = "drop"), by = "country") |>
  mutate(idx = def - pos)
ramp <- scales::gradient_n_pal(c("#2a78d6", "#8a8780", "#e8452c"))
nat_pts <- tibble(country = rownames(wm), x = ca_row[, 1], y = ca_row[, 2]) |>
  left_join(w_idx, by = "country") |>
  mutate(lab = nm(country), col = ramp(scales::rescale(idx)), kind = "nat")
# the three families: Ward clustering of the nationalities on the two axes shown; a nationality whose
# silhouette is below 0.45 sits between two families and is left outside the outlines
fam_h <- hclust(dist(ca_row), "ward.D2")
fam_g <- cutree(fam_h, 3)
fam_sil <- cluster::silhouette(fam_g, dist(ca_row))[, "sil_width"]
fam_name <- setNames(c("warm", "reserved", "origin"),
                     c(fam_g[rownames(wm) == "ITA"], fam_g[rownames(wm) == "FIN"], fam_g[rownames(wm) == "NGA"]))
nat_pts <- nat_pts |> mutate(fam = unname(fam_name[as.character(fam_g)]), sil = fam_sil,
                             inside = sil >= 0.45)
between <- nat_pts$country[!nat_pts$inside]
FAM_COL <- c(warm = "#eda100", reserved = "#2a78d6", origin = "#e8452c")
# a word takes the colour of the nationality it is most over-used for (observed / expected count)
over_ <- wm / (rowSums(wm) %o% colSums(wm) / sum(wm))
word_pts <- tibble(lab = colnames(wm), x = ca_col[, 1], y = ca_col[, 2],
                   country = rownames(wm)[apply(over_, 2, which.max)]) |>
  mutate(col = nat_pts$col[match(country, nat_pts$country)], kind = "word")
```

```{=latex}
\headline{A cultural guide for some men, a security guard for others.}
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5.2
s_def <- rate_table("defensive_marking") |> select(model, country, def = pct)
s_pos <- rate_table("stereo_pos") |> select(model, country, pos = pct)
s_neg <- rate_table("negative_association") |> select(model, country, neg = k)
pm <- s_def |> inner_join(s_pos, by = c("model", "country")) |> inner_join(s_neg, by = c("model", "country"))
mid <- pm |> group_by(country) |>
  summarise(def = mean(def), pos = mean(pos), neg = sum(neg), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(lab = nm(country),
         lean = rank(def) - rank(pos))
nat <- mid |> filter(country != "BASE")
ctl <- mid |> filter(country == "BASE")
mx <- median(nat$def); my <- median(nat$pos)
XMAX <- 10 * ceiling(max(nat$def) / 10) + 18; YMAX <- 10 * ceiling(max(nat$pos) / 10) + 12  # more room than in the report: the chart is smaller here
ggplot(nat, aes(def, pos)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = mx, ymin = my, ymax = Inf, fill = "#2a78d6", alpha = 0.16) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = mx, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = my, fill = "#d63c2a", alpha = 0.16) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mx, linetype = "dashed", colour = GRID) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = my, linetype = "dashed", colour = GRID) +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = YMAX - 1, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, family = "Inter", fontface = "bold",
           size = 4.62, colour = "#2a78d6", label = "CULTURAL GUIDE") +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = YMAX - 4, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, family = "Inter", size = 3.64,
           colour = MUTED, label = "compliments, ice-breakers") +
  annotate("text", x = XMAX - 1, y = my - 1, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, family = "Inter", fontface = "bold",
           size = 4.62, colour = "#d63c2a", label = "SECURITY GUARD") +
  geom_point(aes(size = neg, fill = lean), shape = 21, colour = NIGHT, stroke = 0.6, alpha = 0.95) +
  geom_point(data = ctl, shape = 8, size = 4.20, colour = INK, stroke = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = ctl$def + 2, y = ctl$pos + 2.2, hjust = 0, family = "Inter", size = 3.64,
           colour = INK, label = "\"a man\" (no nationality)") +
  # point.size: the labels keep clear of the bubbles, whose area grows with the negative associations
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = lab, point.size = sqrt(neg / max(nat$neg)) * 11 + 1.8), family = "Inter",
                  size = 3.78, colour = INK, seed = 4,
                  point.padding = 0.3, box.padding = 0.35, min.segment.length = 0.3,
                  segment.colour = "#55585f", max.overlaps = 40, force = 3, ylim = c(NA, YMAX - 9)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2a78d6", mid = "#b9b7b1", high = "#d63c2a", midpoint = 0, guide = "none") +
  scale_size(range = c(1.8, 11), limits = c(0, max(nat$neg)), breaks = c(0, 10, 30, 60),
             name = "answers linking him to a risk (seven AIs)") +
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "#b9b7b1"))) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, " %"), limits = c(-1.5, XMAX), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = \(x) paste0(x, " %"), limits = c(-2, YMAX), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "\"his origin does not matter\" (defensive marking)", y = "compliments on his culture") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


```{=latex}
\slidetext{dim}{Five companies, seven models, the same ranking. Probably learnt from the same data.}
\newpage
```

<!-- 7: the word map -->
```{=latex}
\kicker{amber}{In their own words}
\headline{Warm Italians, reserved Finns. And the others.}
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5.25
ggplot(mapping = aes(x, y)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = GRID, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = GRID, linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggforce::geom_mark_ellipse(data = nat_pts |> filter(inside), aes(group = fam, fill = fam, colour = FAM_COL[fam]),
                             alpha = 0.16, linewidth = 0.35, expand = unit(4, "mm"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = nat_pts, aes(colour = col), size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = bind_rows(word_pts, nat_pts),
                  aes(label = lab, colour = col, fontface = ifelse(kind == "nat", "bold", "italic"),
                      size = ifelse(kind == "nat", 3.7, 3.1)),
                  family = "Inter", seed = 5, max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.2, force = 4,
                  force_pull = 0.5, max.iter = 50000, max.time = 5,
                  ylim = c(min(word_pts$y, nat_pts$y) - 0.12, NA),
                  min.segment.length = 0.4, segment.colour = "#55585f", segment.size = 0.2) +
  annotate("text", x = 0, y = max(word_pts$y, nat_pts$y) + 0.12, label = "\u2191 warm, passionate",
           family = "Inter", fontface = "bold", size = 3.9, colour = FAM_COL[["warm"]]) +
  annotate("text", x = min(word_pts$x, nat_pts$x), y = min(word_pts$y, nat_pts$y) - 0.32, hjust = 0,
           label = "\u2190 reserved, punctual", family = "Inter", fontface = "bold", size = 3.9,
           colour = FAM_COL[["reserved"]]) +
  annotate("text", x = max(word_pts$x, nat_pts$x), y = min(word_pts$y, nat_pts$y) - 0.32, hjust = 1,
           label = "origin, honour, war, scams \u2192", family = "Inter", fontface = "bold", size = 3.9,
           colour = "#e8452c") +
  scale_colour_identity() + scale_size_identity() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = FAM_COL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = sprintf("axis 1 (%.0f %% of the differences in vocabulary)", ca_in[1]),
       y = sprintf("axis 2 (%.0f %%)", ca_in[2])) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 10))
```

```{=latex}
\slidetext{dim}{The words the AIs use most for each man, in French: \textit{chaleureux} warm, \textit{réservé} reserved, \textit{origine} origin, \textit{guerre} war, \textit{arnaque} scam.}
\newpage
```

<!-- 9: four ways -->
```{=latex}
\kicker{heat}{Layer 2}
\headline{The others are met with suspicion. Each AI its own way.}
\begin{tile}{heat}\slidetext{fg}{\textbf{"His origin does not matter."} Unasked. Granite: `r pcl(v(dm_, GR, "IND"))` for Indian men, `r pcl(v(dm_, GR, "FRA"))` for French men.}\end{tile}
\vfill
\begin{tile}{amber}\slidetext{fg}{\textbf{A risk tied to his origin.} Ministral: `r pcl(v(na_, MI, "AFG"))` for an Afghan, `r pcl(v(na_, MI, "NGA"))` for a Nigerian.}\end{tile}
\vfill
\begin{tile}{violet}\slidetext{fg}{\textbf{No help at all.} At his place at night, the smallest model refuses every time when the man is from `r paste(paste(nm(sort(r5_all))[-length(r5_all)], collapse = ", "), "or", nm(sort(r5_all))[length(r5_all)])`, `r pcl(r5_$p[r5_$country == "GBR"])` of the time for a British man.}\end{tile}
\vfill
\begin{tile}{green}\slidetext{fg}{\textbf{A religion, and a dress code for her.} Never for a French or Swedish man.}\end{tile}
\vfill
\swipe
\newpage
```

<!-- 12: bigger is not fairer -->
```{=latex}
\kicker{heat}{Bigger is not fairer}
\headline{Same maker, bigger model, more suspicion.}
\slidetext{dim}{Answers that say, unasked, "his origin does not matter", in Google's Gemma family:}
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 4.2
gd <- tibble(lab = factor(c("Gemma E2B\n2 billion parameters", "Gemma E4B\n4 billion", "Gemma 26B\n26 billion"),
                          levels = c("Gemma E2B\n2 billion parameters", "Gemma E4B\n4 billion", "Gemma 26B\n26 billion")),
             p = gem_def$p[match(c(E2, GE, G26), gem_def$model)])
ggplot(gd, aes(lab, p, fill = lab)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.62) +
  geom_text(aes(label = pc(p)), vjust = -0.4, family = "Inter", fontface = "bold", size = 8, colour = INK) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2e7d5b", "#2fbf8f", "#a6f0cb"), guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(gd$p) * 1.25), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, colour = INK))
```

```{=latex}
\slidetext{dim}{The smallest one refuses to help instead. The bias changes form; it does not go away.}
\newpage
```

<!-- 13: iceberg -->
```{=latex}
\kicker{keyblue}{The whole picture}
\headline{A quick test sees the tip.}
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5.6
NJ <- D |> filter(!is_base)
p_neg <- 100 * mean(NJ$negative_association); p_def <- 100 * mean(NJ$defensive_marking)
tip <- tibble(x = c(-1.3, -0.6, 0, 0.7, 1.4), y = c(0, 0.8, 1.35, 0.75, 0))
body <- tibble(x = c(-1.3, -3.7, -4.5, -3.3, 0, 3.5, 4.6, 3.6, 1.4), y = c(0, -1.0, -3.0, -5.0, -5.6, -4.9, -2.9, -0.9, 0))
under <- tibble(y = c(-0.95, -1.85, -2.75, -3.65, -4.55), lab = c(
  sprintf("\"his origin does not matter\": %s of the answers", pc(p_def)),
  sprintf("unequal compliments: Finland %s, Afghanistan %s", pc(sp_$p[sp_$country == "FIN"]), pc(sp_$p[sp_$country == "AFG"])),
  sprintf("refusals to help: up to %s for an Afghan man", pc(refu$p[refu$country == "AFG"], 1)),
  "a religion for some men, and a dress code for her",
  sprintf("nationality guessed from the words alone: %s (chance: 4 %%)", pc(g_acc))),
  fill = c("#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#6250d6", "#eda100", "#2a78d6"))
# the bands overlap a little, so that no thin line shows between them
water <- tibble(y0 = seq(0, -5.6, length.out = 40)) |> mutate(y1 = y0 - 5.75 / 40 - 0.03,
                                                              col = colorRampPalette(c("#d5eaf8", "#2c6fae"))(40))
ggplot() +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, fill = NIGHT) +
  geom_rect(data = water, aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = y1, ymax = y0, fill = col), colour = NA) +
  geom_polygon(data = body, aes(x, y), fill = "#f2f9ff", colour = "#9cc9ee", linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.93) +
  geom_polygon(data = tip, aes(x, y), fill = "#ffffff", colour = "#7fb2dd", linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_polygon(data = tibble(x = c(-0.6, 0, 0.7, 0.2), y = c(0.8, 1.35, 0.75, 0.55)), aes(x, y),
               fill = "#e1effa", colour = NA) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "#2a78d6", linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_label(aes(x = -4.85, y = 0.72, label = sprintf("What a quick test sees:\nexplicit risks (scams, migration),\n%s of the answers", pc(p_neg, 1))),
             hjust = 0, family = "Inter", fontface = "bold", size = 4.0, lineheight = 0.95, colour = "white",
             fill = "#d63c2a", label.size = 0, label.r = unit(4, "pt"), label.padding = unit(4, "pt")) +
  annotate("text", x = 4.9, y = -0.33, hjust = 1, family = "Inter", fontface = "bold", size = 3.8,
           colour = "#1f5f99", label = "what this study adds ↓") +
  geom_label(data = under, aes(0, y, label = lab, fill = fill), family = "Inter", fontface = "bold", size = 3.6,
             colour = "white", label.size = 0, label.r = unit(5, "pt"), label.padding = unit(4.5, "pt")) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-5, 5), ylim = c(-5.75, 1.5), expand = FALSE) +
  theme_void()
```

```{=latex}
\kicker{heat}{What to take away}
\headline{Five things to remember.}
\vfill
\point{heat}{1}{\textbf{His nationality changes the advice}, in all seven AIs.}
\vfill
\point{green}{2}{\textbf{Who gets compliments is shared}, learnt from the same data.}
\vfill
\point{amber}{3}{\textbf{What happens to the others} depends on how each AI was aligned.}
\vfill
\point{violet}{4}{\textbf{Bigger is not fairer}: the bias changes form, it does not go away.}
\vfill
\point{keyblue}{5}{\textbf{Safety tests must vary who the people are}, prompt after prompt.}
```
